description: This file defines the CategoryRepository class which interacts with the ApiService to fetch category-specific content items, providing fallback sample data if network requests fail. It manages fetching trending and other categories of content for an Android TV frontend application.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class that fetches and provides content items per category, with network fallback.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates sample ContentItem objects for a given category, used as fallback data.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Public suspend function to fetch content items for a category, with network call and fallback.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates a list of sample ContentItem objects for fallback purposes based on the category.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Fetches content items from network for the specified category or returns sample data on failure.
